text: Gorgonzola is made from pasteurised cow's milk inoculated with Penicillium spores, then the paste is perforated during maturation so the mould can develop blue-green veins. Cold, very humid storage and a defined ripening window separate the soft, sweet dolce from the firmer, sharper piccante.

steps.note: The curd is put into perforated moulds.
The soft, sweet dolce is ripened for 50–150 days, the firmer, sharper piccante for 80–270 days.
